bad_guidance.why: Marked GENERIC by the bundle itself; the table already had an empty-state row and there is no async loading in this seeded store, so the record only produced a better empty-state sentence.

guidance_ignored.why: Partially: column resize/reorder/visibility persistence, selection checkbox column with bulk actions, inline edit and loading skeletons were not implemented — out of the sentence's scope at a moderate budget on a read-only catalogue table. Pagination was chosen over virtualisation (both offered) because it needs no dependency and keeps row heights native.
Partially: 'unit in the header not each cell' ignored — the existing formatMoney() prints a leading currency symbol per cell and changing that is a system-wide convention change outside this task.

misses.what: inspect_project reported typography features tabular_numerals: true; no font-variant-numeric / tabular setting exists anywhere in the codebase (the numbers were proportional, which is part of the actual defect). Confident wrong value.
routing: [] and breakpoints: [] although src/router.ts defines 6 vue-router routes; the empty breakpoints list is correct (no @media anywhere) but is reported the same way as the wrong routing value.

spacing 'irregular' / UNKNOWN and theme UNKNOWN although tokens.css declares an explicit 4-pt --space scale and a full [data-theme='dark'] palette; components UNKNOWN although src/components has 9 reusable SFCs.
Neither data.filter_chips nor data.search_results was demanded, although the screen's only narrowing affordances are a FilterBar and a ?q= search whose state is invisible once applied.

table.column_priority carriers were filtered out as platform ['mobile','tablet'] not in ['web']. Column priority is exactly what this 8-column web table needs below ~900px; the web viewport at 390px is still a narrow viewport.
